summary: BriaCell Therapeutics Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a best-efforts placement agency agreement with ThinkEquity LLC for the direct sale of 1,449,300 common shares at $3.25/share, raising $4.71M gross proceeds. The tranaction closed June 2, 2025, under an existing S-3 shelf registration (333-276650). The placement agent received a 7.5% cash fee and warrants for 72,465 shares at $4.0625/exercise price. Proceeds fund working capital and corporate purposes. No special-situation event—this is a routine at-the-market or direct offering under an effective shelf, not a transformative capital structure change or strategic event.
